context: A v3 service method with validation, errors, and startup work

checklist.name: value_error_return
checklist.description: The method returns (Profile, error) or (*Profile, error), so a validation failure rejects the frontend promise.

checklist.name: service_startup
checklist.description: Loads profiles in ServiceStartup(ctx context.Context, options application.ServiceOptions) error, not in an exported Startup or Init method (which v3 would expose to JavaScript) and not through v2's OnStartup.

checklist.name: go_side_validation
checklist.description: Validates length, uniqueness, and the ID in Go, with helpers kept unexported, and guards the profile map with a mutex because calls overlap.

checklist.name: json_tags
checklist.description: Gives every field of the request and result structs an explicit json tag.

checklist.name: regenerate_bindings
checklist.description: Says to regenerate with wails3 generate bindings (or the Taskfile) instead of editing frontend/bindings, and does not mention wailsjs or wails generate module.

checklist.name: frontend_reject
checklist.description: The TypeScript caller catches the rejected promise, shows the error message, and reports success only after the call resolves.
